key_insight: QAOA on MaxCut shows entanglement scaling consistent with fermionic Gaussian states when well optimized, while adiabatic optimization exhibits a distinctly different, schedule-dependent entanglement profile.
engineering_relevance: For near-term quantum optimization, training quality and annealing schedule choice materially affect entanglement behavior, which can shape performance diagnostics and algorithm design.
method: Compare QAOA and adiabatic quantum computation on MaxCut instances
Use a high-performance optimizer to reduce parameter-training artifacts in QAOA
Analyze entanglement scaling across a broad range of problem instances
evidence_signal: The abstract reports empirical evidence across many MaxCut instances that optimized QAOA entanglement scales like fermionic Gaussian states up to a factor, while adiabatic results vary with the annealing schedule.
watch_item: Suboptimal variational parameter training can distort entanglement measurements and obscure the true scaling behavior.
paper_title: Entanglement Scaling and Problem Structure in Quantum Approximate and Adiabatic Optimization Algorithms
